title: AI Agent Sandbox Platform with Reliability Evaluations, Failure Recovery, and Security Containment
challenge: Run Real Agent Work Inside Celesto Sandboxes with Evals and Containment
problem_statement: AI agents interacting with real-world computer environments pose significant risks of data exfiltration, destructive host modifications, and nondeterministic run failures. This platform provides secure isolated microVM sandboxes with pre-execution safety hooks, network policy enforcement, automated failure recovery, and empirical reliability evaluations.
target_workload: Autonomous coding agent resolving software bugs in controlled test repositories
